nodes.name: Store Anonymous Submission
nodes.notes: Anonymous completions (optedIn=false, no PII) land here for future data. Wire this to your store: a Google Sheets 'Append', a Postgres/MySQL insert, a Cloudflare D1 query, or an Airtable 'Create'. Useful columns: submissionId, submittedAt, domain, primaryTask, priorityScore, priorityBand, annualROI, temperature, readinessTier. The matching opt-in event (if any) shares the same submissionId.
